text: Outcome: remove private Root geodesic Dijkstra/adjacency through reusable graph4s distances and typed mesh4s adapter. Scope: graph4s prepared indexed-undirected source distances plus one private CSR Dijkstra shared with DirectedRoutes; mesh4s graph adapter transports exact vertex/edge owners; Root retains validation/cache/matrix policy. Invariants: finite nonnegative costs, zero edges, repeated ordered targets, disconnected Infinity, custom costs without triangle inequalities; no casts/renumbering. Overflow reachability explicit as Some(Infinity) versus unreachable None upstream, legacy Root maps both to Infinity. Tests: independent Floyd-Warshall, existing DirectedRoutes path/tie/custom-Hash tests, owner compile refusals, mesh oracle, Root cache regression and scientific fixture gates on JVM/JS. Source overrides must resolve one graph URI across providers; default immutable pin cascade/publication is a separate qualified step. Work in fresh normal clones graph4s-eco-distances-20261020 at856e6fb and mesh4s-eco-distances-20261020 atb9e0553; preserve older dirty checkouts. Next implement and qualify provider APIs before Root cutover.
